mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.5%) signal sustained monetary accommodation, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate financing costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 10.0% indicates severe labor market distress that triggers corporate earnings revisions downward, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal synchronized recovery across construction and manufacturing sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days via improved corporate demand outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO rise, or interaction term coefficient p-value > 0.05 in regression model.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1) during post-recession recovery phases indicates strengthening consumer and business spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as corporate earnings improve sustainably.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive during recovery phases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent price pressures that trigger expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) reflects strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous Federal Funds rate declines and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) signal aggressive monetary policy response to economic weakness, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days via policy-driven risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE > 8.0%, or interaction term coefficient p-value > 0.05 in regression model.

mechanism_narrative: Rebounding industrial production (INDPRO) from pandemic lows during post-shock recovery phases signals normalized supply chains and manufacturing output, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days as corporate margins stabilize.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rebounds from pandemic lows, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.
